+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""repo_dump.py - Dump a GitHub repository's issues, PRs, releases and all
+attached media back into the repository (mobile-triggerable via Actions).
+Python 3 stdlib only.
+Usage: GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_xxx python3 tools/repo_dump.py --repo OWNER/NAME [--budget 900]
+Output: markdown + JSON + media under repo-dump/ (committed by the workflow).
+"""
+import argparse, json, os, re, sys, time, urllib.request, urllib.parse
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+
+API = "https://api.github.com"
+UA = {"User-Agent": "repo-dump-tool/1.0 (github-attachment-dumper)"}
+MEDIA_RE = re.compile(
+    r"https://(?:github\.com/user-attachments/(?:assets|files)/[\w\-./%]+"
+    r"|user-images\.githubusercontent\.com/[\w\-./%]+"
+    r"|github\.com/[\w.\-]+/[\w.\-]+/assets/[\w\-]+)")
+
+def req_json(url, token):
+    r = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=dict(UA, Accept="application/vnd.github+json"))
+    if token: r.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=60) as resp:
+        return json.loads(resp.read() or b"null")
+
+def paged(path, token):
+    page = 1
+    while True:
+        sep = "&" if "?" in path else "?"
+        items = req_json(f"{API}{path}{sep}per_page=100&page={page}", token) or []
+        if not items: return
+        yield from items
+        if len(items) < 100: return
+        page += 1
+
+def download(url, dest, token):
+    if os.path.exists(dest) and os.path.getsize(dest) > 0:
+        return "cached"
+    # Media URLs (user-attachments / user-images) are public and REJECT
+    # Authorization headers with HTTP 400 -> never send the token here.
+    for attempt in (1, 2):
+        try:
+            r = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=dict(UA))
+            with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=180) as resp, open(dest, "wb") as f:
+                f.write(resp.read(200_000_000))
+            return "ok"
+        except Exception as e:
+            if os.path.exists(dest): os.remove(dest)
+            if attempt == 2: return f"FAILED: {e}"
+            time.sleep(2)
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--repo", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--out", default="repo-dump")
+    ap.add_argument("--budget", type=int, default=900, help="media download budget seconds")
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    token = os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN")
+    t0 = time.time()
+    out, media = a.out, os.path.join(a.out, "media")
+    issues_d, prs_d, rel_d = (os.path.join(out, x) for x in ("issues", "pulls", "releases"))
+    for d in (media, issues_d, prs_d, rel_d): os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
+    manifest = {"repo": a.repo, "issues": [], "pulls": [], "releases": [], "media": {}}
+
+    # PASS 1: text dump + collect media URLs (fast, always completes)
+    for it in paged(f"/repos/{a.repo}/issues", token):
+        n, body = it["number"], it.get("body") or ""
+        is_pr = bool(it.get("pull_request"))
+        url_path = f"/repos/{a.repo}/pulls/{n}/comments" if is_pr else f"/repos/{a.repo}/issues/{n}/comments"
+        comments = list(paged(url_path, token))
+        md = [f"# {it['title']}  (#{n})", f"- state: {it['state']}  author: {it['user']['login']}  created: {it['created_at']}", "", "## body", body, "", f"## comments ({len(comments)})"]
+        for c in comments:
+            md.append(f"### {c['user']['login']} @ {c['created_at']}\n\n{c.get('body') or ''}\n")
+        if is_pr:
+            md.append("## review comments")
+            for rc in paged(f"/repos/{a.repo}/pulls/{n}/comments", token):
+                md.append(f"### {rc['user']['login']} @ {rc['created_at']} ({rc.get('path','')})\n\n{rc.get('body') or ''}\n")
+        open(os.path.join(prs_d if is_pr else issues_d, f"{n:05d}-{re.sub(r'[^\w\-]+','_',it['title'])[:60]}.md"), "w").write("\n".join(md))
+        (manifest["pulls"] if is_pr else manifest["issues"]).append(
+            {"number": n, "title": it["title"], "state": it["state"], "author": it["user"]["login"],
+             "created_at": it["created_at"], "comments": len(comments), "url": it["html_url"]})
+        for u in MEDIA_RE.findall("\n".join(md)): manifest["media"].setdefault(u, None)
+
+    for r in paged(f"/repos/{a.repo}/releases", token):
+        body = r.get("body") or ""
+        md = [f"# {r['name'] or r['tag_name']} (tag {r['tag_name']})",
+              f"- author: {r['author']['login']}  published: {r.get('published_at')}", "", body, "", "## assets"]
+        for s in r.get("assets", []):
+            md.append(f"- {s['name']} ({s['size']} bytes) {s['browser_download_url']}")
+            manifest["media"].setdefault(s["browser_download_url"], None)
+        open(os.path.join(rel_d, f"{re.sub(r'[^\w\-]+','_',r['tag_name'])}.md"), "w").write("\n".join(md))
+        manifest["releases"].append({"tag": r["tag_name"], "name": r["name"], "assets": len(r.get("assets", [])), "url": r["html_url"]})
+
+    # PASS 2: parallel, resumable, budgeted media download
+    urls = list(manifest["media"].keys())
+    print(f"pass1 done in {time.time()-t0:.0f}s; {len(urls)} media files to fetch", flush=True)
+
+    def job(u):
+        name = urllib.parse.unquote(u.split("?")[0].rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]) or "attachment"
+        if not os.path.splitext(name)[1]: name += ".bin"
+        dest = os.path.join(media, name)
+        i = 1
+        while os.path.exists(dest) and u != manifest["media"].get(dest):
+            cand = os.path.join(media, f"{i}_{name}")
+            if not os.path.exists(cand): dest = cand; break
+            i += 1
+        return u, dest, download(u, dest, token)
+
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as ex:
+        for u, dest, res in ex.map(job, urls):
+            manifest["media"][u] = os.path.relpath(dest, out) if not res.startswith("FAILED") else res
+            if res not in ("ok", "cached") and time.time() - t0 > a.budget:
+                break
+
+    json.dump(manifest, open(os.path.join(out, "manifest.json"), "w"), indent=2)
+    idx = [f"# Repo dump: {a.repo}", "",
+           f"Generated by repo-dump-tool (Mercury AI, stdlib Python) at {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC', time.gmtime())}.",
+           "", f"## Issues ({len(manifest['issues'])})"] + [f"- #{i['number']} [{i['state']}] {i['title']} ({i['comments']} comments)" for i in manifest["issues"]]
+    idx += ["", f"## Pull requests ({len(manifest['pulls'])})"] + [f"- #{i['number']} [{i['state']}] {i['title']} ({i['comments']} comments)" for i in manifest["pulls"]]
+    idx += ["", f"## Releases ({len(manifest['releases'])})"] + [f"- {r['tag']}: {r['name']} ({r['assets']} assets)" for r in manifest["releases"]]
+    ok = sum(1 for v in manifest["media"].values() if v and not str(v).startswith("FAILED"))
+    idx += ["", f"## Media ({len(manifest['media'])}, {ok} saved)"] + [f"- {k} -> {v}" for k, v in manifest["media"].items()]
+    open(os.path.join(out, "README.md"), "w").write("\n".join(idx) + "\n")
+    print(f"DONE: {len(manifest['issues'])} issues, {len(manifest['pulls'])} PRs, {len(manifest['releases'])} releases, {ok}/{len(manifest['media'])} media -> {out}/  [{time.time()-t0:.0f}s]")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
